traits.name: Draconic Ancestry
traits.desc: Choose a dragon type (Black/Acid, Blue/Lightning, Brass/Fire, Bronze/Lightning, Copper/Acid, Gold/Fire, Green/Poison, Red/Fire, Silver/Cold, White/Cold). Affects Breath Weapon and Damage Resistance.

traits.name: Breath Weapon
traits.desc: Replace one attack with a 15-ft Cone or 30-ft Line. Each creature makes a Dex save (DC 8 + Con mod + Prof Bonus) or takes 1d10 damage (your dragon type). Scales: 2d10 at lvl 5, 3d10 at lvl 11, 4d10 at lvl 17. Uses = Prof Bonus per Long Rest.

traits.name: Damage Resistance
traits.desc: Resistance to the damage type of your Draconic Ancestry.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: Darkvision 60 ft.

traits.name: Draconic Flight (Level 5)
traits.desc: Bonus Action: sprout spectral wings, gain Fly Speed equal to your Speed for 10 minutes. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: Darkvision 120 ft.

traits.name: Dwarven Resilience
traits.desc: Resistance to Poison damage. Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Poisoned condition.

traits.name: Dwarven Toughness
traits.desc: HP maximum increases by 1, and increases by 1 again each time you gain a level.

traits.name: Stonecunning
traits.desc: Bonus Action: gain Tremorsense 60 ft for 10 minutes (must be on or touching stone). Uses = Prof Bonus per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: Darkvision 60 ft.

traits.name: Elven Lineage
traits.desc: Choose Drow, High Elf, or Wood Elf. Drow: Darkvision 120 ft, Dancing Lights; lvl3 Faerie Fire; lvl5 Darkness. High Elf: Prestidigitation; lvl3 Detect Magic; lvl5 Misty Step. Wood Elf: Speed 35 ft, Druidcraft; lvl3 Longstrider; lvl5 Pass without Trace.

traits.name: Fey Ancestry
traits.desc: Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Charmed condition.

traits.name: Keen Senses
traits.desc: Proficiency in Insight, Perception, or Survival (choose one).

traits.name: Trance
traits.desc: You don't need sleep. You can finish a Long Rest in 4 hours of trancelike meditation.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: Darkvision 60 ft.

traits.name: Gnomish Cunning
traits.desc: Advantage on Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma saving throws.

traits.name: Gnomish Lineage
traits.desc: Choose Forest Gnome or Rock Gnome. Forest: Minor Illusion cantrip + Speak with Animals (Prof Bonus times per Long Rest). Rock: Mending + Prestidigitation cantrips + Tinker (create Tiny clockwork devices, 3 at a time, fall apart after 8 hours).

traits.name: Giant Ancestry
traits.desc: Choose one boon (Prof Bonus uses per Long Rest): Cloud's Jaunt (teleport 30 ft), Fire's Burn (+1d10 Fire on hit), Frost's Chill (+1d6 Cold, target speed -10 ft), Hill's Tumble (knock prone), Stone's Endurance (Reaction: 1d12+CON damage reduction), Storm's Thunder (Reaction: 1d8 Thunder damage to attacker).

traits.name: Large Form (Level 5)
traits.desc: Bonus Action: become Large for 10 minutes (Advantage on STR checks, +10 ft Speed). Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Powerful Build
traits.desc: Advantage on ability checks to end the Grappled condition. Count as one size larger for carrying capacity.

traits.name: Brave
traits.desc: Advantage on saves to avoid or end the Frightened condition.

traits.name: Halfling Nimbleness
traits.desc: You can move through the space of any creature larger than you.

traits.name: Luck
traits.desc: When you roll a 1 on a d20, you must reroll the die and use the new roll.

traits.name: Naturally Stealthy
traits.desc: You can take the Hide action even when obscured only by a creature at least one size larger than you.

traits.name: Resourceful
traits.desc: You gain Heroic Inspiration whenever you finish a Long Rest.

traits.name: Skillful
traits.desc: You gain proficiency in one skill of your choice.

traits.name: Versatile
traits.desc: You gain an Origin feat of your choice.

traits.name: Adrenaline Rush
traits.desc: Bonus Action: take the Dash action and gain Temporary Hit Points equal to your Proficiency Bonus. Uses = Prof Bonus, regained on Short or Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: Darkvision 120 ft.

traits.name: Relentless Endurance
traits.desc: When reduced to 0 HP but not killed outright, drop to 1 HP instead. Once per Long Rest.

traits.name: Darkvision
traits.desc: Darkvision 60 ft.

traits.name: Fiendish Legacy
traits.desc: Choose Abyssal, Chthonic, or Infernal. Abyssal: Poison Resistance, Poison Spray; lvl3 Ray of Sickness; lvl5 Hold Person. Chthonic: Necrotic Resistance, Chill Touch; lvl3 False Life; lvl5 Ray of Enfeeblement. Infernal: Fire Resistance, Fire Bolt; lvl3 Hellish Rebuke; lvl5 Darkness.

traits.name: Otherworldly Presence
traits.desc: You know the Thaumaturgy cantrip.
